title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: A few quick answers about the way we work, what we deliver, and how to get started.

items.title: What services does MFD Solutions offer?
items.answer: We provide web and mobile app development, UI/UX and graphic design, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI and automation, e-commerce, and ongoing IT support.

items.title: How does a project get started?
items.answer: Start with a conversation about your goals. We’ll clarify the scope, recommend an approach, and share a clear timeline and estimate before work begins.

items.title: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the scope and requirements. The example plans on this page start at $499; custom work is quoted after an initial consultation.

items.title: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Support and maintenance are available after delivery, and each project includes the support period set out in its proposal.

items.title: Can you work with clients outside Saudi Arabia?
items.answer: Yes. Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, MFD Solutions delivers projects remotely to clients worldwide.

items.title: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Send a note using the contact form and include a few details about your project. We’ll follow up to discuss next steps.
